hook.name: Floor
hook.description: ERC20 token that is also its own Uniswap v4 AMM hook, implementing a custom bonding curve (x − F) · y = k where F is a monotonically increasing price floor that grows by 1% of each swap's input. All swaps are fully absorbed via BeforeSwapDelta and restricted to a single authorized router; liquidity additions, removals, and donations are permanently disabled.
